items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1961-02-16
items.q: Did you ever go see, uh, Cuttrell play... Oh, yeah, last time. We played against one, yeah.

ctx.x: Now, he's a man, first, man, bought the first drum method for me, Carl Fisher method.
Oh, yeah. Did you ever go see, uh, Cuttrell play, you know, with Piran?
Oh, yeah, last time. We played against one, yeah.
